title: Monomorphisms and representable morphisms are read off the first diagonal, and the second diagonal is always a monomorphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks is a monomorphism exactly when its first diagonal is an isomorphism, that it is representable by algebraic spaces exactly when that diagonal is a monomorphism, and that the second diagonal is always a monomorphism (author lemma at source lines 1741-1750, label lemma-hierarchy). The proof (source lines 1752-1765) quotes the cross-chapter characterization for monomorphisms, uses that the second diagonal is a monomorphism to upgrade the representability criterion to an equivalence, and reads off the final assertion (proof lines 1752-1763). The upgrade of the representability criterion to an if and only if is the content. H2.
